mechanism: Bumetanide causes electrolyte depletion and dehydration which increases loperamide absorption and toxicity risk, while loperamide's antimotility effects may worsen fluid loss and electrolyte imbalance.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes closely, maintain adequate hydration, and consider alternative antidiarrheal agents; use loperamide cautiously only if diarrhea is clearly drug-induced.
